problems.description: Attackers send emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into submitting their login credentials on fake websites.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) across all accounts
Deploy advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
Conduct regular user awareness training and phishing simulations

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing emails crafted using personal information to deceive specific individuals into revealing sensitive data or executing malicious actions.
risk_reduction: Use threat intelligence to identify targeted campaigns
Train employees on recognizing social engineering tactics
Verify unusual requests through secondary communication channels

problems.description: Attackers compromise or spoof executive email accounts to request fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive information from employees.
risk_reduction: Enforce strict email authentication protocols (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)
Establish verification procedures for financial transactions
Monitor email accounts for unusual sending patterns

problems.description: Misconfigured cloud storage services (e.g., S3 buckets, Azure blobs) expose sensitive data publicly or to unauthorized users, leading to data breaches.
risk_reduction: Implement automated configuration scanning and compliance checks
Enforce least privilege access policies
Use cloud provider security posture management (CSPM) tools

problems.description: Attackers infiltrate organizations by compromising software vendors, service providers, or hardware suppliers to insert malicious code or backdoors.
risk_reduction: Conduct rigorous vendor risk assessments
Implement software bill of materials (SBOM) tracking
Monitor for unusual activity in third-party integrations

problems.description: Use of AI-generated synthetic media (audio, video) to impersonate trusted individuals and manipulate victims into divulging information or performing actions.
risk_reduction: Deploy deepfake detection technologies
Establish multi-channel verification for sensitive requests
Raise awareness about synthetic media threats

problems.description: Attackers inject malicious data into training datasets to corrupt machine learning models, causing misclassification or degraded performance.
risk_reduction: Validate and sanitize training data rigorously
Use robust and explainable ML models
Monitor model behavior for anomalies post-deployment

problems.description: Attackers not only encrypt victim data but also exfiltrate sensitive information, threatening to release it publicly if ransom is not paid.
risk_reduction: Implement robust data backup and recovery processes
Encrypt sensitive data at rest and in transit
Monitor network traffic for exfiltration indicators
